```yaml
name: Update eslint-plugin-sonarjs Changelog

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight

jobs:
  update-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Update changelog
        id: update_changelog
        run: |
          node tools/update-changelog.js
          echo "changelog_updated=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.update_changelog.outputs.changelog_updated == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update eslint-plugin-sonarjs changelog"
          title: "Update eslint-plugin-sonarjs changelog"
          body: "This PR updates the changelog with recent changes."
          branch: "update-changelog"
          delete-branch: true
```
